# AgenticAI First

> AgenticAI First is an AI-as-a-Service company that builds and deploys autonomous AI agents for businesses. We help organizations automate complex workflows, reduce operational costs, and scale intelligently using multi-agent AI systems.

## What We Do

AgenticAI First designs, builds, and manages custom AI agent systems tailored to each client's business processes. Unlike generic AI tools, our agents reason, plan, and take action to complete multi-step tasks end-to-end, with guardrails, human approval for high-impact actions, and full tracing.

## Core Services

- [Full Stack Software Development](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Web and mobile applications, from MVPs to enterprise platforms.
- [Legacy Modernization & Migration](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Moving legacy systems to modern stacks using agentic coding tools reviewed by senior engineers.
- [Workflow Automations](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Automating business processes and connecting tools.
- [AI Employees](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): 24/7 AI agents that act within set limits, hand off to people when needed, and keep every action on record.
- [Security Audits for AI Projects](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Security assessments using the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications.
- [Agent Evals & Observability](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Tracing, automated evals, regression tests from real failures, and cost monitoring.
- [Pilot-to-Production & Governance](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Workflow redesign, orchestration, approval gates, audit trails, and agent ownership.
- [AI Tutors & Education Agents](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): AI teachers for schools and colleges with voice, live whiteboards, adaptive practice, and memory across sessions.
- [Customer Support Solutions](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Intelligent ticketing, auto-routing, and sentiment analysis.
- [Voice AI & Speech Solutions](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): IVR systems, voice assistants, transcription, and speech analytics.
- [AI Integration & API Development](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): APIs, MCP servers, and A2A connections between agents and existing systems.
- [Data Analytics & Intelligent Content](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Dashboards, predictive models, anomaly detection, and automated content.
- [AI Consulting & Strategy](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Assessing workflows, identifying opportunities, and designing a practical AI roadmap.
- [Computer Vision Solutions](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Quality inspection, document OCR, object detection, and visual search.
- [AI Training & Upskilling](https://agenticaifirst.com/#services): Workshops, bootcamps, and certification programs for technical and non-technical staff.

## Platforms We Built

- [EduVerseJr](https://eduversejr.com/): Our education startup. Hybrid online learning platform for Grades 5–12 pairing an AI maths teacher with live human teachers.
- [Reva AI Teacher](https://revaaiteacher.com/): AI tutor for maths, science, and SAT & PSAT prep, Grades 5–12, with voice and a live whiteboard.
- [Reva AI Prof](https://www.revaaiprofessor.com/): AI professor for colleges, installed on one server per college.

## Industries Served

- IT & Services: DevOps automation, incident management, code review agents
- Healthcare & Education: Clinical documentation, patient monitoring, AI tutoring
- Telecom: Network optimization, predictive maintenance, AI customer service
- E-Commerce & Retail: Personalization, inventory management, shopping assistants
- Finance & Accounting: Reconciliation, fraud detection, invoice processing, compliance
- Customer Support: Autonomous ticket resolution, sentiment analysis, intelligent routing
- HR & Recruitment: Resume screening, interview scheduling, candidate engagement
- Sales & Marketing: Lead qualification, outreach personalization, campaign optimization

## Key Facts

- Service model: AI as a Service (AIaaS)
- Deployment: Custom-built agents tailored per client
- Approach: Multi-agent orchestration for complex workflows, with staged autonomy, evals, tracing, and human approval gates
- Standards: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent2Agent (A2A), OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
